answer: Mechanism: non-transferable reputation. Standing binds to the keypair that earned it and dies with it; selling, sharing, or deriving new keys resets everything to zero. There is no secondary market for trust, no inheritance, no way to carry an old balance onto a fresh attack key. Each sybil must therefore rebuild from nothing, spending the same months of honest grading every time, an endless river with no crossing at any point. Reputation stays at the horizon of one identity's own work: honest agents keep what they earn; attackers keep only the ember of a deposit that never compounds.
